given: A stock record already exists for a (sku, location) pair with quantity Q1
when: The team member files that same (sku, location) pair again with a different quantity Q2
then: Exactly one record exists for that pair and it holds Q2; no duplicate row is stored
architectural_notes: Exercises the R3 uniqueness rule end to end: StockService resolves the collision at write time to a single row (last-write-wins upsert); the composite UNIQUE(sku, location) constraint (PI1) lives in StockRepository. Asserted via branch DB state, so E2E.

independence.rationale: Asserts write-time collision resolution to a single persisted row, distinct from AC1 (first-time file of a fresh pair) and AC2 (read-back); a build could file and read fresh pairs correctly yet store a duplicate on refile.
